messages.subject: [IT] Scheduled DMS maintenance — Saturday 17 Jan 20:00-23:00
messages.plaintextBody:
The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable this Saturday 17 January between 20:00 and 23:00 for scheduled maintenance. Please check in any open documents beforehand. No action is required otherwise.

IT Helpdesk | Whitfield Carter LLP
